question: Does legitimate tenant-safe current-scope 8192-input prefix reuse clear the 10% L40S cost gate?

strongest_admissible_proxy.claim_limit: synthetic exact identity only; not an empirical 8K distribution and not a cross-tenant reuse claim

normalized_8k_upper_bound.method: optimistically transfer 176 reusable tokens to an 8192-token request and assume linear prefill wall time with zero cache overhead
normalized_8k_upper_bound.note: This is an intentionally generous scale proxy; the source fixture is synthetic and only 4392-token, so it cannot support promotion.

identity_blockers: The frozen workload contract permits exact prefix identity only for synthetic-owned records.
The fixed 8192/1024 records contain no prompt content or reusable-prefix identity.
The retained V2 tokenizer/runtime binding fails reproduction: all 24 requests observed 164 rather than expected 183 server input tokens.
The frozen replay schema does not carry cache_salt, so its claimed tenant/session isolation is not conveyed to vLLM.

promotion_rule.reason: No source-backed 8192 replay reaches the required evidence threshold; duplicated synthetic prompt remains stress-only.
promotion_rule.minimum_reopen_evidence: A versioned current-runtime bundle with legally usable source-backed 8192 request content, exact tokenizer identity, tenant/session cache isolation, reusable-token distribution, and scheduler/cache telemetry supporting at least 5499 reusable prefix tokens per request on the bound mix.
